item.title: Evening Weather for Friday, September 04
item.description: Good evening! Here's your weather for Friday, September 4. It's Friday. The weekend is very nearly here! In Shanghai today, expect it to be damp with light drizzle. The high will be 30 degrees, and the low will be 25 degrees. There is a 90 percent chance of rain. Don't forget your umbrella today! Listen out for the rain on the window today. It sounds like tiny drums. And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be drizzly, with a high of 30 degrees. A question for you: what is something you are really good at? And that's the weather. Have a brilliant day!
